app.name: Linear
app.managed_alternative_note: Composio provides managed Linear connectors for creating issues, sync cycles, and updating project milestones with zero OAuth configuration.
when_to_byoc: Custom branding: Display your application name and icon on the Linear OAuth consent screen
Dedicated webhook infrastructure: Direct delivery of issue and cycle webhooks to private endpoints
Enterprise audit logs: Direct integration with organizational Linear security audit trails

summary: Fast, clean developer experience. Instant self-serve OAuth application registration with standard PKCE and webhook support.
difficulty_factors: +15 pts: Multi-workspace OAuth requires registered OAuth client and PKCE
+0 pts: No review required for direct OAuth install URLs
+0 pts: Free workspaces can create and authorize OAuth applications

time_estimate.production_wait_claim: Instant for direct OAuth distribution (no review required)

prerequisites: Linear workspace account with Admin role
HTTPS callback URL (http://localhost is permitted for development)

path.action: Go to Linear Workspace Settings -> API
path.detail: Open Linear -> Click Workspace Settings -> Navigate to 'API' tab -> Scroll down to 'OAuth applications'.
Click 'Create OAuth Application'. Enter Application Name, description, and Redirect URIs.

path.action: Copy Client ID and Client Secret
path.detail: Linear displays the Client ID and generates a Client Secret. Store securely in your environment variables.
Direct users to https://linear.app/oauth/authorize with client_id, redirect_uri, scope, and code_challenge.

scopes.unlocks: Read user profile, workspace teams, and issues
Create, update, and close issues, projects, and comments
Granular scope restricted to creating new issues only
Administer workspace members, webhooks, and billing

approval.what_reviewed: No review process exists for standard OAuth applications distributed via direct URL. Review is optional only for listing in Linear's public directory.
typical_rejection_reasons: No review rejections occur for private or direct-link apps
what_to_prepare: App name, logo, and valid HTTPS callback URL

blockers_and_fixes.cause: Linear requires PKCE for authorization code flow. If code_verifier does not match code_challenge SHA-256 hash, token exchange fails.
blockers_and_fixes.fix: Ensure code_verifier is stored in session and hashed with SHA-256 base64url encoding without padding.

agent_can_do: Generate GraphQL queries and mutations using Linear SDK
Implement PKCE state and challenge generation
you_must_do: Log into Linear workspace settings as Admin
Create OAuth Application and save Client Secret
agent_vs_human.handoff_critical_point: Human must create the OAuth Application in Linear Workspace Settings -> API.

what_to_do_next: Navigate to Linear Settings -> API -> Create OAuth Application.
Paste Client ID & Secret into your agent environment.
Run PKCE authorization flow with 'read' and 'write' scopes.

evidence.claim: Linear OAuth applications can be registered directly by any workspace admin with no approval queue
evidence.snippet: Workspace administrators can create OAuth applications directly from Workspace Settings -> API. Once created, client credentials are immediately available for use.

evidence.claim: Linear supports standard PKCE and GraphQL endpoints for all entity operations
evidence.snippet: All interactions with Linear data are performed through our GraphQL API at https://api.linear.app/graphql using Bearer token authentication.

uncertainties: Linear tokens currently do not expire by default unless revoked, but token rotation support is recommended for future-proofing.

facts.quote: Create OAuth applications in Linear API settings.
OAuth applications can be authorized immediately by workspace users.
